description: We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is a critical leadership opportunity to oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance. We are looking to fill this vital role quickly, with a target start date around June 30th.As the Director of Nursing, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the quality of life for our residents and fostering a supportive environment for our nursing staff. This position offers a competitive annual salary of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence. Join a team that values compassionate care and professional growth.If you are a visionary nursing leader ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply immediately. This is an excellent chance to advance your career in a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of progressive nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
Ability to manage and mentor a diverse nursing team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience.
